focus.text:
(i)Applicants may submit a request electronically.

(ii)An electronic request under clause (i) must include the applicant’s name and reference number.

(iii)The agency must publish annual statistics on requests submitted under clause (i).

(i)Applicants may inspect public records during opening hours.

(ii)The agency must publish annual statistics on inspections under clause (i).

or generalize an example. Unknown evidence must remain unknown. A component can
remain unstructured when the complete meaning is faithful; do not demand an
